# Studio Birdcage

> Welcome to Studio Birdcage!

Studio Birdcage is a personal/project blog with posts, series, and resource pages.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://studiobirdcage.com/): Latest posts and site index.
- [Series](https://studiobirdcage.com/series/): Post series index.
- [Resources](https://studiobirdcage.com/resources/): Resource index.
- [RSS feed](https://studiobirdcage.com/rss.xml): Blog feed.
- [Sitemap](https://studiobirdcage.com/sitemap-index.xml): Complete crawl map.
